name: CL Web AI Images for WooCommerce
author: clclweb

sections.description:
CL Web AI Images for WooCommerce helps store owners create professional product visuals directly from the WordPress admin.

  • Generate product images from existing photos and a simple prompt
  • Choose landscape (4:3), square (1:1), or vertical (9:19) formats
  • Templates, scenes, visual styles, and multi-image variations
  • Automatic SEO-friendly filenames and alt text
  • Publish generated images straight into the WooCommerce product gallery
  • Connect with Google to manage credits and subscription

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or later
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later
  • A free Google account (required to generate images)
  • Internet connection (images are generated via the Woo AI Images API)

External services

This plugin relies on external services to work. Without them, image generation and account management are not available.

Woo AI Images API

Used for site registration, credit balance, Google account linking, and AI image generation.

  • What is sent: site URL, plugin version, product title, text prompt, optional reference product images (base64), aspect ratio, and authenticated account/site tokens.
  • When: on plugin activation (registration), when you connect your Google account, when you refresh credits, and each time you generate an image.
  • Service provider: CL Web Design
  • API endpoint: https://apiwooia.clwebdesign.fr
  • Terms of use: https://wooaiimage.com/terms.html
  • Privacy policy: https://wooaiimage.com/privacy.html

Google Sign-In

Used to create and link your Woo AI Images account to your WordPress site.

  • What is sent: OAuth authorization is handled by Google; the plugin receives your Google profile (name, email, avatar) after you approve access.
  • When: when you click “Continue with Google” on the account or checkout pages.
  • Service provider: Google LLC
  • Terms of use: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

wooaiimage.com (optional)

Used only if you open the subscription or checkout pages linked from the plugin.

  • What is sent: standard web browser requests; your Google session if you are logged in on that site.
  • When: when you click a subscription or account management link.
  • Terms of use: https://wooaiimage.com/terms.html
  • Privacy policy: https://wooaiimage.com/privacy.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to AI Images → My account and connect your Google account.
  4. Open a product and generate your first image.
sections.faq:
Do I need to configure an API key?

No. Install the plugin, connect your Google account, and start generating.

How many free generations do I get?

Each site receives 5 free credits. Additional credits are available through a paid subscription on wooaiimage.com.

How much does one generation cost?

One credit per image. If you choose 3 variations, 3 credits are used.

Do credits renew every month?

Free credits are a one-time allowance per site. Paid subscribers receive 100 credits per month per linked site, renewed on each billing cycle.

Are images added to the product automatically?

Yes. Each generated image is added to the WooCommerce product gallery.

  • Plugin display name updated to CL Web AI Images for WooCommerce
  • Added External services documentation, Requires Plugins header, and contributor update

  • Add Save button after image generation to refresh the page
